apps.name: Photos Backup
apps.localizedDescription:
## New

- **Add to Matching Albums.** Opt-in toggle under **Settings → Backup** (off by default). Files new uploads into Google Photos albums matching their iOS albums (or parent folder for picked folders), creating each album the first time. ([#35](https://github.com/g8row/PhotosBackup/issues/35), [#36](https://github.com/g8row/PhotosBackup/pull/36), thanks @devenchande)
- **Folder backup from Files / iCloud Drive.** New **Pick Folder** card on Home scans a chosen folder recursively for photos and videos and queues them through the durable upload pipeline. ([#35](https://github.com/g8row/PhotosBackup/issues/35), [#36](https://github.com/g8row/PhotosBackup/pull/36), thanks @devenchande)
- **Re-upload Selected Albums.** Under **Settings → Re-check**, force-upload every item in the selected albums (skipping the duplicate check) under your current Storage Saver and storage quota settings. ([#12](https://github.com/g8row/PhotosBackup/issues/12), [#30](https://github.com/g8row/PhotosBackup/pull/30), thanks @josippapez)
- **Every frame of a burst is now backed up.** PhotoKit hides non-key burst frames by default, causing Google Photos to treat bursts as not backed up. All library reads, exports, and album lookups now include every burst frame. ([#45](https://github.com/g8row/PhotosBackup/pull/45), thanks @saileshbro)

## Fixed

- **Background processing windows hand control back to iOS reliably.** Background windows, Shortcuts runs, and upload-result wakes are now capped at 2 simultaneous uploads. On expiry, logs flush immediately, unfinished work pauses and disarms the crash-loop guard, and an off-MainActor 3 s fallback guarantees `setTaskCompleted` is called even if the main actor is busy or keep-alive is active. ([#45](https://github.com/g8row/PhotosBackup/pull/45), [#46](https://github.com/g8row/PhotosBackup/pull/46))
- **Silent audio keep-alive handles Bluetooth/AirPods disconnects and interruptions safely.** Observes audio route changes (`.oldDeviceUnavailable`) to restart silent playback automatically, checks `player.isPlaying` for `isRunning`, and disarms the preparation crash-loop guard during phone-call/audio interruptions so a jetsam while interrupted does not falsely fail in-flight items. ([#46](https://github.com/g8row/PhotosBackup/pull/46))
- **Location keep-alive switching fixed.** Switching to Location no longer kills an active audio keep-alive before permission is granted, attaches the authorization delegate properly, and starts automatically as soon as permission is allowed. ([#46](https://github.com/g8row/PhotosBackup/pull/46))
- **Better Keep-Alive & iOS 26 Live Activity coordination.** Respects `.serious`/`.critical` thermal state on continuation expiry, adds a 30 s grace period for brief Wi-Fi drops before ending the Live Activity, stops Keep-Alive immediately on Pause, requeues in-flight tasks cleanly on timeout, and starts continuation immediately on manual backup taps (no 1 s throttle race when locking immediately). ([#46](https://github.com/g8row/PhotosBackup/pull/46))
- **Background URLSession stall watchdog & relaunch drain fixed.** The 15-minute watchdog now reconciles live tasks via `getAllTasks` and checks for stored results before cancelling (so healthy suspended transfers are not discarded on wake). Relaunch drains now only attach to transfers that have a stored result or persisted receipt rather than spinning 25 s on unrelated in-flight uploads. ([#46](https://github.com/g8row/PhotosBackup/pull/46))

## Notes

- 227 tests, 225 passing, 0 failing (2 opt-in live tests skipped) on Xcode 26.
- The unsigned `.ipa` and its `.sha256` are built from this tagged commit by GitHub Actions and attached automatically.
